Help/shortcut panel sources - `src/shell/help.rs` — no cut-feature lines: it is a generic renderer (`help_rows`/`render_help` driven by `help_sections` from `keymap.rs`; `help_actions` derives from the same rows). Nothing to deregister here beyond what §1–2 already cover. - `src/shell/keymap.rs:353-360` — `editable()` derives the rebindable set from `help_sections`, so removing the rows above automatically drops them from the editable set too (integrator note, not a separate line to delete). 6. `src/logic/commands.rs` — palette command catalogue (NOT off-limits; report for the crew) - `src/logic/commands.rs:507` — `"app::NewFromTemplate",` (+508 label `tr("New note from a template", …)`, 509 icon, 510 `Create`) - `src/logic/commands.rs:525` — `"editor::OpenEmbed",` (+526-529 `tr("Open the embedded note (on its line)", …)`, 530 icon, 531 `Go`) - `src/logic/commands.rs:534` — `"app::Today",` (+535 `tr("Today's note", …)`, 536 icon, 537 `Go`) - `src/logic/commands.rs:558` — `"nav::ShowGraph",` (+559 `tr("Graph of the notes", …)`, 560 icon, 561 `Go`) - `src/logic/commands.rs:563` — `("nav::ShowTags", "Tags", "tag.svg", Go),` - `src/logic/commands.rs:565` — `"nav::ShowLinks",` (+566 `tr("Backlinks", …)`, 567 icon, 568 `Go`) - `src/logic/commands.rs:571` — `"nav::ShowCalendar",` (+572 `tr("Calendar", …)`, 573 icon, 574 `Go`) - `src/logic/commands.rs:679` — `"app::ToolAsTab",` (+680-683 `tr("Open the graph or the calendar as a tab", …)`, 684 icon, 685 `Go`) - No catalogue entries for `nav::OpenDay`, `nav::PrevMonth`, `nav::NextMonth`, nor for insert-template / save-as-template (templates appear in the catalogue only as `app::NewFromTemplate`; insert/save-as surface only via the `keymap.rs:60` palette hint). 7. Book index + chapters - `book/src/SUMMARY.md:14` — `- [Links, embeds and files](links.md)` - `book/src/SUMMARY.md:16` — `- [Daily notes, templates and capture](daily-notes.md)` - `book/src/SUMMARY.md:20` — `- [The palette and the panel](navigation.md)` - Content pages (file-level only, per brief): `book/src/links.md` (backlinks/tags/embeds), `book/src/daily-notes.md` (today/calendar/templates/capture), `book/src/navigation.md` (panel views incl. graph). `book/src/shortcuts.md` is generated from `help_sections` (header says `Do not edit by hand: run make docs`) and will refresh once §1 rows are removed. 8. `docs/index.html` + `README.md` - `docs/index.html:203` — `

Links and graph

And also: … templates, … embedded sections, …` (also mentions tags/backlinks-adjacent lists in the same paragraph). - `README.md:21` — `- **Linked notes.** \`[[Links]]\`, backlinks, tags, embedded sections, a graph, and a calendar of daily notes. …` - `README.md:74` — `| [Links, embeds and files](book/src/links.md) | links, backlinks, tags, embedded sections, pictures, dropped files |` - `README.md:76` — `| [Daily notes, templates and capture](book/src/daily-notes.md) | today's note, the calendar, templates, quick capture |` - `README.md:77` — `| [The palette and the panel](book/src/navigation.md) | the tree, the graph, the trash, icons |` 9. Action-name cross-reference (which shared-registry files reference each) - `nav::ShowGraph` — `keymap.rs:118,540`; `commands.rs:558`; `main.rs:42` mentions the non-existent `nav::Graph` in example text only. - `nav::ShowTags` — `keymap.rs:119,541`; `commands.rs:563`. - `nav::ShowLinks` — `keymap.rs:120,542`; `commands.rs:565`. - `nav::ShowCalendar` — `keymap.rs:121,543`; `commands.rs:571`. - `nav::PrevMonth` / `nav::NextMonth` — `keymap.rs:555-556` bindings only; no help `k()` row, no catalogue entry. - `nav::OpenDay` — no references anywhere in the shared registries (no `k`/`p`/`b`, no catalogue, no declaration hit outside dispatch logs). - `editor::OpenEmbed` — `keymap.rs:325,626`; `commands.rs:525`. - `app::NewFromTemplate` — `keymap.rs:59`; `actions.rs:44`; `commands.rs:507`; no default `b()` binding. - `app::Today` — `keymap.rs:61,390`; `actions.rs:40`; `commands.rs:534`. - `app::ToolAsTab` — exists in `actions.rs:27`; `keymap.rs:96` help row; `commands.rs:679`; no default `b()` binding. How pieces connect: `src/actions.rs` declares the `app::` actions; `src/shell/keymap.rs` advertises them (`help_sections` k/p rows, which also feed `editable()`, the `F1` panel, and generated `book/src/shortcuts.md`) and binds keys (`defaults()` b rows); `src/logic/commands.rs::catalog()` exposes the same names to the palette; `src/main.rs` help text only echoes one stale example (`nav::Graph`); `SUMMARY.md`/`README.md`/`docs/index.html` mirror the features in prose.
